key.name: autosave-delay-minutes
key.description: Minutes of inactivity after the last edit before an autosave is written (doc 09).

key.name: default-preview-scale
key.description: Preview render scale selected when the app starts; the transport bar's own dropdown can still be changed per-session without affecting this default.

key.name: shuttle-max-speed
key.description: Upper bound (in multiples of normal speed) the J/K/L shuttle ramps up to.

key.name: recent-projects-max
key.description: Maximum number of entries shown in the header bar's recent-projects popover.

key.name: worker-threads
key.description: Threads in the background pool that probes imports and loads and saves projects (doc 19). 0 picks automatically: half the CPU cores, at least 2. Read at startup.

key.name: cache-jobs
key.description: Pool threads the timeline's thumbnail and waveform caches may use at once. 0 picks automatically: half the pool. Read at startup.

key.name: reopen-last-project
key.description: Open the project that was open when the app last closed, unless there is unsaved work to recover.

key.name: last-project-path
key.description: The project open when the app last ran; empty if it was untitled.

key.name: snap-while-dragging
key.description: Dragged clips and edges snap to nearby clip edges.

key.name: follow-playhead
key.description: The timeline scrolls a page at a time to keep the playhead in view during playback.

key.name: show-timeline-thumbnails
key.description: Video clips on the timeline show frames from their source.

key.name: show-waveforms
key.description: Clips with sound show their waveform on the timeline.

key.name: show-inspector
key.description: Whether the inspector (the Effects, Add and other add-on pages) is open beside the picture when the window is wide enough to dock it.

key.name: show-hover-preview
key.description: A video clip's tooltip shows the source frame under the pointer.

key.name: default-project-folder
key.description: Where Open and Save As start; empty for the file chooser's own default.

key.name: default-export-folder
key.description: Where renders go; empty for the project's folder, then Videos, then home.

key.name: render-threads-percent
key.description: How much of the machine a render may use, as a percentage of its hardware threads. Applies from the next render.

key.name: default-render-profile
key.description: The render profile the Render button uses: a built-in's name or one from render-profiles.ini.

key.name: gpu-acceleration
key.description: Composite and place clips on the graphics card where a check at startup says it works (Automatic); off, everything is done on the processor.

key.name: hardware-decode
key.description: While GPU acceleration is on, decode video files on the graphics card where it can; falls back to the processor by itself.

key.name: gpu-probe-cache
key.description: Internal: the last GPU check's result and the versions it was made with.

key.name: use-proxies
key.description: Play each clip's proxy, where it has one, instead of its file (renders always use the files).

key.name: proxy-height
key.description: Height of new proxies in pixels; 0 is the source's own size (a conformed proxy).

key.name: help-open-sections
key.description: Help's expanded sections, as "tab:section".

key.name: help-tab
key.description: The Help tab shown last.

key.name: help-scroll
key.description: Each Help tab's scroll position, as "tab=pixels".

key.name: disabled-drop-ins
key.description: Names of installed drop-ins not to load (Settings, Drop-ins). Applies from the next start.
